InclusionCriteria.IC1: Overweight or obese subjects [according to body mass index (BMI)]
InclusionCriteria.IC2: Fasting plasma glucose value between 100 and 125 mg/dl, with impaired fasting glucose or impaired glucose tolerance confirmed with oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT)

ExclusionCriteria.EC1: Patients with neoplastic and liver diseases, renal failure
ExclusionCriteria.EC2: Patients with type 1 or 2 diabetes mellitus
ExclusionCriteria.EC4: Hypersensitivity to any of the ingredients
ExclusionCriteria.EC6: Use of products containing red yeast rice
